outcome_access: No P13 predictive, crossover-effect, or field-log outcome was accessed while resolving this execution contract.

candidate_resolution.primary: Reuse the exact P03 EXP-C09-T3 candidate selected from source-only evidence for the same station, held instrument, outer repeat, and outer fold.
candidate_resolution.fixed_families: Within each named family, reuse the lexicographic winner from the same P03 EXP-C09-T3 source-only selection trace. Verify the four previously materialized C10 family winners exactly.
candidate_resolution.preprocessing_sensitivity: Hold the resolved candidate fixed across PP-U-MIN, PP-U-SG, and PP-U-ARPLS so the paired sensitivity changes preprocessing rather than model selection.
candidate_resolution.unrepresented_exploratory_domain: When no P03 source-only selection exists, C-SELECTED is unavailable with no substitution. Fixed secondary families use their first declared candidate and remain exploratory.

roles.outer_training: Same station and substrate family, non-held instruments, physical masters outside the current P02 outer-test fold.
roles.calibration: Cross-fitted source-only predictions using the matching P02 inner-master registry; if that registry does not exist for the exploratory domain, use each non-test P02 outer fold as a validation fold.
roles.held_test: Same station, substrate family, and held instrument on current P02 outer-test masters.
roles.matched_source_test: Same station and substrate family, non-held instruments, restricted to current outer-test masters that also have a held-instrument view.

calibration.method: single scalar temperature from source-only cross-fitted scores
calibration.technical_seed_rule: Average score vectors over every declared candidate seed before temperature fitting and final prediction.

sharding.unit: domain by preprocessing policy by outer repeat

primary_metric: three-class balanced accuracy after technical-repeat probability averaging within master-substrate-instrument view
matched_loss: source balanced accuracy minus held balanced accuracy on physical masters having both held and source views
repeated_outer_prediction: Average each observation's calibrated out-of-fold probabilities over the five outer repeats before technical-repeat and instrument-view aggregation.

crossover.predictive_scope: PP-U-MIN for every frozen classical procedure; F46 emphasizes C-SELECTED and the fixed RBF sensitivity.
crossover.required_prediction_cells: All four held-view cells for substrate A and B crossed with instrument A and B must have completed out-of-fold predictions; otherwise retain the block as unavailable for the predictive contrast.
crossover.correctness_contrast: For each master, compute [(correct_B,instrument_B - correct_A,instrument_B) - (correct_B,instrument_A - correct_A,instrument_A)].
crossover.true_class_probability_contrast: Use the same difference-in-differences orientation on calibrated true-class probability.
crossover.representation_distance: On PP-U-MIN master-view mean spectra, compute cosine distance between instrument A and B within each substrate and report distance_B minus distance_A.
crossover.intervals: Master bootstrap for blocks with at least two masters; descriptive point estimate only for singleton blocks.

field_log.repeat_handling: Agreeing nonmissing technical-repeat log values define the view value; conflicts are ambiguous.
field_log.success_definition: Y is successful recorded detection for nonblank analytes and N is successful recorded specificity for blank analytes.
field_log.definite_endpoint: Exclude M and conflicting views; retain truly missing views for best- and worst-case bounds.
field_log.model_agreement: On definite field-log views, compare recorded success/failure with correct/incorrect PP-U-MIN out-of-fold analyte classification from the same view.
field_log.model_scope: Report every frozen classical procedure; F47 emphasizes C-SELECTED.

portability_rule.loss_condition: UCB95(source minus held balanced accuracy) <= delta

prohibitions: held spectra or labels in fitting, candidate resolution, calibration, or threshold selection
candidate substitution after a fit failure
changing the P13 support tier after outcome access
using P13 outcomes to select P04 architecture or optimization
